title: Agency Team
subtitle: Manage team members, roles, and property management permissions.
inviteNotAllowed: Only the owner or an admin can invite members.

table.title: Team members & access levels
table.count: {count, plural, =0 {No team members yet} one {# team member registered} other {# team members registered}}
table.rolesOwnerOnly: Only the owner can change roles

owner.title: 1. Owner
owner.description: Full legal and financial control. Receives CCP / BNA payouts, configures agency settings and manages billing.

admin.title: 2. Admin
admin.description: Listing and fleet management. Can create and edit listings, adjust prices, manage the calendar and invite team members.

manager.title: 3. Manager / staff
manager.description: Day-to-day operations. Can view incoming reservations, message guests, coordinate check-in/check-out and check calendar availability.

invite.title: Invite a team member
invite.emailRequired: Enter a valid work email address.
invite.description: You get an invitation link to send them. They join your workspace with the role you choose.

removeDialog.title: Revoke team access
removeDialog.message: Remove {name} from {organization}? They will immediately lose access to your agency dashboard, calendar and bookings.

transferDialog.title: Transfer ownership
transferDialog.message: Make {name} the owner of {organization}? You will become an admin.

toasts.ownerCannotBeRemoved: The organization owner can't be removed.
toasts.resendComingSoon: Invitation emails are coming soon. For now, share the invitation with {email} directly.

invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.count: {count, plural, =0 {No pending invitation} one {# pending invitation} other {# pending invitations}}
invitations.empty: No invitations yet. Invite a teammate to share the workspace.
invitations.revokeMessage: The invitation link sent to {email} will stop working.

linkDialog.title: Share the invitation link
linkDialog.description: Invitation emails are not sent yet. Send this link to {email} yourself: they sign in with that email and join your team.
linkDialog.label: Invitation link
linkDialog.once: This link is shown only once and works for 7 days. If you lose it, cancel the invitation and create a new one.
linkDialog.copyFailed: Couldn't copy the link. Select it and copy it by hand.

accept.title: Join the team
accept.description: You were invited to join an organisation on BLADUS. You will join it as {email} and can switch to its workspace from the host menu.
